runs.text: Place each set of kiosk data in the shape that suits it best.

Different values of one thing go in a record; a closed list of values, in an enumeration; data that grows, in a vector; data looked up by something, in a dictionary; a fixed amount of values of the same type, in an array.
The name, the price and the stock of a product.
The day's sales, which keep arriving without knowing how many there will be.
The price of each product, looked up by its name.
The seven temperatures of a week.
